title: CESCR statement on poverty and the International Covenant on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
publisher: OHCHR / Committee on Economic, Social and Cultural Rights
research_limitations: rights-based multidimensional definition is not a single-frame diagnostic
duration and power relations require context beyond appearance
reuse_note: Use as a decomposition and claim-limit source; never as a visual prototype or a basis for inferring poverty from a person.

title: June 2025 Update to Global Poverty Lines
research_limitations: a statistical threshold cannot be read from cash or clothing
international and national lines are not interchangeable visual labels
reuse_note: Keep monetary poverty as metadata; require an explicit resource-action-result relation instead of a money prop alone.

title: 2025 Global Multidimensional Poverty Index
research_limitations: the index aggregates household indicators and is not a photographic checklist
health education and duration are not safely inferable from visible traits
reuse_note: Use to keep deprivation dimensions separate; do not stack every indicator into one stigmatizing scene.

title: Applying the Food Insecurity Experience Scale
research_limitations: FIES is an experience survey with a reference period rather than an image classifier
an empty bowl or small portion alone does not establish food insecurity
reuse_note: Translate only component-rich access and portioning events; retain duration and severity labels as advisory.

title: Famine facts
research_limitations: famine requires population-level thresholds and converging evidence
no portrait food prop or landscape can prove famine
reuse_note: Route famine and 기아 away from hard single-image activation; use only as a severity claim-limit source.

title: Malnutrition
research_limitations: malnutrition spans deficiency excess and imbalance
body shape skin face or apparent frailty cannot support a diagnosis
reuse_note: Forbid malnutrition and health-state inference from appearance; no positive visual candidate is derived.

title: Persons at risk of poverty or social exclusion (sdg_01_10)
research_limitations: survey items encode enforced inability and household context
a worn item cold color grade or missed outing alone is not deprivation evidence
reuse_note: Use as a dimension map and for exact relation contrasts, not as a bag of aesthetic poverty tokens.

title: Energy poverty
research_limitations: thermal discomfort has climatic building and equipment confounds
an inactive heater may reflect preference maintenance outage or vacancy
reuse_note: Require occupied-home continuity plus service constraint and coping response; reject blue tint and cozy winter shorthand.

title: The Right to Adequate Housing, Fact Sheet No. 21/Rev.1
research_limitations: adequacy combines legal social and physical dimensions
one crack mold patch or small room does not establish inadequate housing
reuse_note: Use only the observable habitability path for a hard contract; keep tenure affordability and accessibility as contextual claims.

title: Working poverty rate
research_limitations: working poverty is a household income classification not a visual occupation type
night work uniforms fatigue and rough hands are non-diagnostic
reuse_note: Activate only when the request explicitly supplies paid work and an essential-cost shortfall; never infer it from occupation or appearance.

title: World Survey on the Role of Women in Development 2019
research_limitations: time poverty depends on accumulated schedules and gendered context
one busy scene or tired face cannot establish persistent time deprivation
reuse_note: Keep as a sequence-only candidate bundle until multi-frame or explicit duration evidence is supported.

title: Transport and inequality
research_limitations: transport disadvantage can arise from service geography time reliability or disability as well as fare
waiting missing a vehicle or standing outside a gate alone is ambiguous
reuse_note: Hard-route only a stated essential trip with a visible fare-resource gap and immediate blocked departure.

title: Affordable Connectivity
research_limitations: connectivity depends on price device quality skills coverage and policy
a broken phone public computer or no-signal icon does not isolate affordability
reuse_note: Keep at P1 and require explicit affordability or timed-shared-access causality plus an unfinished essential task.

title: OECD Toolkit to Combat Homelessness: Measurement, definitions, data and drivers
research_limitations: there is no fully harmonized international definition
location appearance or a person outdoors cannot prove housing status or duration
reuse_note: Keep homelessness and housing insecurity out of hard portrait routing; use only explicit sequence and status context in a deferred bundle.

title: Menstrual hygiene
research_limitations: the topic involves sensitive health and bodily privacy
product absence or restroom imagery alone cannot establish a person's condition or unmet need
reuse_note: Keep candidate-only with explicit non-invasive material and facility context; do not infer menstruation or health from a person.

title: Illustrative Guide to the Dóchas Code of Conduct on Images and Messages
research_limitations: ethical guidance does not guarantee generated-image fidelity or consent
symbolic imagery can still become reductive without contextual gates
reuse_note: Apply as a cross-profile composition guard: same eye level, visible agency, traceable systems, no victimizing crop or spectacle.

title: Visual empathy: capturing poverty through a stigma-free lens
research_limitations: the article describes a participatory image practice that synthetic generation cannot reproduce
technical prompt compliance is not equivalent to lived-experience approval
reuse_note: Use to shape respectful viewpoint and agency; keep requesting-user judgment as a distinct final layer.

title: Ethical reporting guidelines
research_limitations: reporting ethics do not authorize synthetic depiction of a real child or prove consent
child vulnerability is amplified by identifying details and decontextualized hardship imagery
reuse_note: Default all human candidates to unmistakably adult; child-related requests require an explicit protected workflow outside this proposal.

title: Youth indicators: relative poverty rate
research_limitations: the median-income threshold is statistical and household-based
being outside a venue owning fewer goods or showing envy cannot establish relative poverty
reuse_note: Keep the statistical term advisory; the hard contract represents only an explicit same-activity affordability barrier.

title: Housing support policy Q&A for vulnerable residents
publisher: Ministry of Land, Infrastructure and Transport, Korea
research_limitations: policy eligibility combines place type duration income and administrative criteria
a basement gosiwon or jjokbang-like room alone is not proof of poverty or eligibility
reuse_note: Use Korean place terms only as contextual metadata or explicitly supplied setting; never as a hard poverty trigger.
